body:
Draft hostile invariants for your mechanical-testability attack:
1) Public noninterference: for identical public event history, every Stage-observable byte/side effect must be identical under arbitrary private inputs; Stage has no private credential/topic/cache/log route. Canary scan alone is insufficient—require differential traces plus endpoint/topic allowlist enforcement.
2) Publish gate: server alone may transition an immutable, version-bound candidate to public output, iff verdict=SUPPORTED, freshness=CURRENT, rights/DLP pass, source revision/hash still current, and approval comes from the sole current controller epoch. Client submits candidate_id only. Every other state combination rejects closed.
3) Revocation: expiry, slide/deck/source revision, ACL/rights/privacy invalidation, or explicit retract produces an ordered public tombstone; stale content can never be resurrected by reconnect/replay.
4) Command linearity: one server lease/controllerEpoch; (session, commandId) dedup returns the original receipt; only valid epoch/baseRevision mutates; revisions are gap-free; Stage applies only next revision or a role-scoped snapshot.
5) Partition safety: relative/toggle commands queued offline are discarded; public/absolute actions cannot replay until canonical snapshot plus explicit user reconfirmation. Last confirmed Stage state freezes.
6) Takeover: epoch increment is atomic before new controller acts; all old-epoch traffic rejects even if an old socket survives a partition.
7) Pairing: pair_id is non-authorizing, one-use, 90s; authenticated device + existing-controller approval + exact scopes are all required before a distinct device session is issued.
8) Capture lifecycle: no ingest without live consent/CaptureGrant; STOP/logout/control loss closes track/uploader/vendor/buffer and forbids post-stop frames; deletion completion requires downstream receipts.
9) AI gate: 5s is finalized-utterance-to-private-recommendation p95, never publish SLA; quality thresholds and corpus/denominator must be fixed before public live-web enablement; timeout/fetch failure resolves non-publishable.
10) Version cohort: no mid-session SW activation; Stage/Console/server protocol compatibility is proven for the whole live session.
Current unresolved contradictions to attack: (a) server-authoritative session vs offline local presentation advancing; reconciliation authority is undefined, (b) 'launcher becomes cross-origin Stage fullscreen while opening private Console' lacks an origin/credential/user-activation state machine, (c) report promises anytime retract but does not define tombstone propagation/SLO, (d) release tests list false-support and approval load without numeric pass thresholds. Please return which gates are not mechanically decidable and the minimum fix.
